meta.method: One row per 2021 ABS Suburb and Locality (SAL) in South Australia. Postcode, council and remoteness area are the ABS Postal Area, LGA and Remoteness Area holding the largest share of the SAL's 2021 usual residents (mesh block allocation, area breaks ties). SEIFA is the 2021 IRSAD decile; decileSa ranks SALs within South Australia. pop is the 2021 Census usual resident count.
